subject: Notice of Funding Availability and Action Plan
overview: The board approved the revised developer application and draft Notice of Funding Availability pending legal review, debriefed the recent community feedback, and voted to petition the Community Preservation Committee for additional funding.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the February 5, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Funding Application Guidelines and Frameworks
items.summary: Approved the updated affordable housing developer application and approved the draft Notice of Funding Availability as amended, pending legal review regarding funding language.

items.title: Action Plan Working Group Update
items.summary: Debriefed the March 12th community meeting and survey results, reviewed draft action plan updates, and agreed to submit a summary letter to the Community Preservation Committee.

items.title: Funding of the Trust
items.summary: Discussed the tabled McCormick Avenue parcels transfer and alternative municipal funding options, and approved a motion to request an additional $50,000 from the Community Preservation Committee.
